Irene / Karthik — thanks for the context. Attached is a redline set for the MSA (Talon_MSA_v3_redlines.docx). Summary of the material changes we propose: 

1) Term and pricing
- Accept 18-month term starting 2028-07-01. Pricing: we can offer a 7% committed-term discount vs list for the uplift tranche; need commercial signoff.

2) Order form / billing schedule
- Add an Exhibit B (Capacity & Billing) that lists monthly committed units amortized across the term; include a mid-term adjustment process for additional purchases.

3) Data residency / keys
- Propose an Addendum confirming US-only processing for PHI-tagged workloads with KMS integration (customer-managed keys option). Include standard audit log retention 12 months; if they need 24 months we’ll consider as an add-on.

4) SLA & credits
- Recommend keeping our standard SLA language but increase outage credit cap to 10% for sustained incidents > 6 hours to help procurement signoff. Avoid custom availability definitions that create open-ended obligations.

5) Liability / termination
- Hold to our current liability cap but include carveouts for gross negligence; remove unlimited liability requests. Termination: include a 60-day cure period for service-level breaches before termination for convenience.

Questions for commercial: (Karthik / Irene)
- Do we accept the 7% discount on the uplift tranche? If yes, I’ll bake numbers into the order form.
- Who will be the signer on Talon side? If it’s CFO Anna, we should route via DocuSign with the PO number in DocuSign envelope.

I attached the redline doc and a one-page summary for Evan. Once you confirm the discount and signing path I’ll finalize for circulation.
